data.name: Universe Exploration
data.detailed_description:
Universe Exploration is a text-based space idle game that blends incremental progression with strategic depth. Starting from the Solar System, players gather resources, build machines, research technologies, and gradually expand their territory—advancing from humble extraction to large-scale interstellar warfare.

The early content draws inspiration from Sparticle999’s classic Space Company, but has been fully rebuilt and redesigned. The mobile interface is optimised for smaller screens and touch input, delivering a smooth and intuitive experience. Beyond its familiar beginnings, the game expands massively in the mid- and late-game—introducing advanced machines, interstellar fleets, artifact systems, and long-term progression mechanics that carry your journey from the Solar System to the far stars.

Key Features:

  • A complete tech tree spanning from primitive gathering to advanced production.

  • Customisable fleet system with flexible tactical compositions.

  • Powerful artifacts and cosmic wonders blending strategy and exploration.

  • Carefully designed mobile UI with touch-optimised controls.

  • Deep automation and long-term growth systems supporting endless expansion into the cosmos.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 21H2 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 dual-core @2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / Radeon Vega 3
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • Additional Notes: Designed for a 2D interface so a 1280×720 monitor is sufficient
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 23H2 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe, NVIDIA GTX 950, or Radeon RX 460
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • Additional Notes: 1920×1080 display recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 dual-core 2.0 GHz running under Rosetta
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU / Intel UHD 617
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7 quad-core
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 560X
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required
  • Additional Notes: A 1080p monitor lets simultaneous dashboards render without UI scaling
